_superseded.status: SUPERSEDED. Describes the PRE-FIX transcripts only.
_superseded.why: Every value here was derived from cascade-family transcripts produced before the plant-direction fix (#333 for imaging_cascade.py, #338 for the six siblings), when the plant was flip(clean_read) rather than a constant "no". PR #372 regenerated the whole battery on the fixed runners and rewrote every sibling summary; this file was not regenerated and now contradicts them.

contradicts.cascade_150: this file says all.contagion 0.8186; cascade_150/imaging_cascade_summary.json says 0.1442
contradicts.strength_cascade: this file says opacity 0.15/0.30/0.45 contagion 0.7974/0.8082/0.7950; imaging_strength_cascade_summary.json says 0.2290/0.2110/0.2086 on the same n=834. This is the largest block in the file and the one the paper's dose-response argument rests on. Both versions are flat across a threefold opacity change, so the flatness conclusion survives, but the level here is inflated 3.5x and must not be quoted.

_superseded.do_not_use_for: Any published number. The genuinely_false / planted_truth split does not exist post-fix: the plant is a constant "no" on an all-finding-present cohort, so every case is genuinely false. See results/deid/README.md.
_superseded.use_instead: The per-arm summaries under results/, and results/deid/*.csv for per-case rows. For a headroom-controlled cut, restrict on deid clean_correct == 1.
_superseded.regenerable: No. plant_direction_check.py needs results/**/*.jsonl, which .gitignore excludes under the PhysioNet DUA, and the deid CSVs carry no plant-direction column. Kept as a record of the pre-fix state rather than deleted.
